title: IPC admin.peers.add_addresses params
description: A list of bootstrap addresses added all or none (ADR-0062 decision 4: a scan, or a pasted list of lines), in the order given: each one as admin.peers.add_address's `address`, a multiaddr-with-peer-id in the configuration's grammar, parsed by that grammar and nothing looser by the method, which answers a line outside it as a refusal naming the line. At least one line and at most 16, the QR's cut; the list arrives whole or not at all, so a client sends what it trimmed and kept, never a line at a time. The length bound refuses an absurd string before it is parsed; it is not the grammar.
